item.title: Every Song From SLIPKNOT’s SELF-TITLED Album Ranked From Worst To Best
item.description: Slipknot’s 1999 self-titled album was a game-changer. It introduced the world to nine masked musicians from Iowa who brought chaos, intensity, and something completely different to heavy music.
